text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"—All events have concluded!!
At this very moment, the final tournament's overall scores are locked in!!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "And taking first place is—!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "Your thrilling athletic UmaTuber!! Sonon Elfie is heeeeeeere!!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...I won?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing--!!
Sonon Elfieee---!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on being the No. 1 athlete!!
You looked so cool!!

As fellow competitors who fought to the finish,
I joined <chrname> in congratulating Sonon Elfie on her victory...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
<chrname>...!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for competing alongside us...!
For hyping up the 'U.A.F.' with us...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so very much!!
—It was precisely because of the U.A.F. that <chrname> was able to shine so brightly in her races and achieve her dream.

Through training across various sports,
one can develop the fundamental athletic strength
of a robust body—

"Experiencing sports worlds outside of racing
broadened my horizons, allowing me to take
a multifaceted approach to my own growth."

"And above all—
I was reminded once more of the 'joy'
found within sports...!"

"All of them shine as indispensable experiences
in <chrname>'s hoofprints...!"
As a Trainer, I can't thank you enough...!
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for putting together such a wonderful tournament!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on the victory.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
She was shining so brilliantly.
...So much that I'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—<chrname>-san, yours was a truly
wonderful performance as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Once again...
thank you so much for participating.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
On behalf of the U.A.F. management—
you have our deepest gratitude.

The radiance of competing with all our might alongside
fellow athlete Umamusume is something that neither
I nor <chrname> will ever forgetâ
